label: batch-31
tail:
Completed batch 31: all seven reserved A items and the B example are authored, with both pages, manifest, coverage, proof contracts, notes, and cross-batch dependency records.

**Scoped checks passed:** precheck 8/8, strict proof contracts 8/8, coverage with 25 harvested results, source resolution 14/14 (8 fetch stamps and 6 documented drops), rendercheck on all 8 items and 2 pages, proof-layout with 23 steps and 0 defects, and dependency levels across batches 22, 23, and 31.

Three items have ready records. Five remain escalated because their batch 22 suppliers have stale readiness hashes or the batch 23 inverse-momentum supplier is escalated. Their consuming proofs are complete and explicitly conditional; the corresponding edges remain open in the [cross-batch ledger](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-31.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

The full-run readiness check is blocked by batch 42’s malformed item entries (`Duplicate item undefined`). Full-run dependency checking also reports other empty inventories; contract coverage stops at batch 10’s empty inventory, and the full dependency-ledger collector reports an invalid review in batch 11. I recorded batch 31’s readiness using the record command against a temporary scope of batches 22, 23, and 31; the three ready hashes were checked against that scope. The live run still requires owner repair and recertification.

Key artifacts: [A page](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/relativistic-particle-mechanics/rpm-controlled-limits.md), [B page](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/library/relativistic-particle-mechanics/rpm-controlled-limits-examples.md), [batch manifest](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-31.pages.json), [proof contracts](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-31.proof-contracts.json), and [batch notes](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-td-qft-rpm-62-2026-10-14-batch-31.notes.md).

Source coverage includes [OpenStax University Physics, Vol. 3](https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/5-8-relativistic-momentum), [Tong’s GR notes](https://davidtong.org/teaching/general-relativity/grhtml/S5), [Carroll’s GR notes](https://preposterousuniverse.com/wp-content/uploads/grnotes-four.pdf), and [Iyer’s ODE notes](https://www.math.cmu.edu/~gautam/c/2026-632/notes/existence.html). The shared workspace shows changes from other in-flight batches; I left those files, the shared plan, and engine state untouched.
